config.hypothesis: Two-sided: the matched study found restart planning with branches equal to BC in coverage under the modified simulator; this tests whether that ordering, and the branch and restart effects, hold under the original gym-pusht dynamics, starts and success measure.
config.status: Registered before any model was evaluated in gym-pusht. Frozen ral-evidence-v2 checkpoints, no retraining. gym-pusht seeds its own start distribution from each episode seed. The dev bank is unused because nothing is tuned.
